method: Actual skinned vertices; nearest triangle distance and normal; 14 double-sided ray parity votes (7 opposite direction pairs), deduplicated equal-distance crossings. High confidence means >=12/14 odd parity votes plus inward nearest normal. Not a watertight volume guarantee.
limits: Samples vertices, not triangle interiors or continuous animation. Thin crossings may fall between vertices.
Open/nonmanifold weapon geometry, overlapping shells, flipped normals and coplanar/tangent rays can produce ambiguous classifications. Consensus is diagnostic, not mathematical proof.
Nearest negative normal alone is never labeled penetration.
Full mode samples 5 phases per clip, not continuous motion. Reload support hand remains unconstrained and is still measured.
